verdict.rationale: Merge requests are referenced pervasively across the evidence pack as the core collaboration unit — security findings, Chat search, third-party integrations (Notion, PagerDuty), and GitHub-import parity all treat MRs as the central discuss/review/merge construct, and gitlab-comm-3 confirms PR/MR review comments and workflow parity with GitHub. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party doc excerpt walking through creating/discussing/approving/merging an MR (approvals, threads, merge rules) rather than only peripheral mentions.
